C1463.title: Hackers Exploit Old ScadaBR Vulnerability to Attack Water Plant ICS
C1463.summary: In December 2025, the pro-Russian hacking group TwoNet exploited the ScadaBR vulnerability CVE-2021-26829, which was patched in 2021, to compromise a water treatment plant's ICS honeypot and deface its HMI login page.
